stationContext: Stasiun Whoosh Halim is the Jakarta terminus of the KCIC Jakarta-Bandung high-speed railway, located in the Halim Perdanakusuma area (Kec. Makasar, Jakarta Timur), near the Cawang/Jatinegara hotel cluster along Jl. MT Haryono and Jl. DI Panjaitan. No official KCIC source publicly names any crew accommodation facility at Halim; KCIC instead published an open tender (Feb 2026) for external accommodation and transport management services for expatriate annual leave and employee business travel through December 2026.

missingInfo: No official KCIC source (kcic.co.id, official press release, or official Whoosh site) names any crew accommodation/mess facility at Halim; therefore zero properties are classified VERIFIED_OFFICIAL_KCIC.

Verified straight-line or road distances to Stasiun Whoosh Halim are unavailable for most properties; published figures are mostly to Halim Perdanakusuma AIRPORT. The Hive (1.77 km) and H Residence (1.4 miles) distances come from OTA listings referencing 'Halim' station and could not be cross-confirmed (Traveloka snippet for The Hive suggests ~1 km).
Coordinates unavailable for all properties except Swiss-Belinn Cawang (official page map embed).
No crew/corporate rates, room allocations, occupancy, or contract terms are publicly disclosed for any property.
No guesthouse or homestay near Stasiun Whoosh Halim could be verified with a concrete address from a fetched source; candidates exist on OTAs but Traveloka/tiket.com pages are bot-blocked.
Park Hotel Cawang room count is inconsistent on the owner's page (162 vs 156); official parkhotel.co.id site not independently fetched.
Vasaka official website (dafamhotels.com) unreachable at check time; verification relies on Trip.com listing.

Ask whether KCIC operates or leases any dedicated crew mess/lodging at or near Stasiun Whoosh Halim (KCIC Halim office: Jl. Akses Kereta Cepat Halim Perdanakusumah, Kel. Halim Perdana Kusuma, Kec. Makasar, Jakarta Timur 13610, per kcic.co.id contact page).
Request crew accommodation rate cards, room allocations/capacity, and booking/occupancy arrangements for train crews and staff on business travel at Halim.

Request official confirmation of which nearby public hotels (e.g., Best Western Premier The Hive, Swiss-Belinn Cawang, Park Hotel Cawang, Harper MT Haryono, favehotel PGC Cililitan, Vasaka) hold corporate/crew contracts with KCIC, if any.
